result.description:
About us

I.J. Projects is a family-founded building and project management company with over 50 years of industry experience, delivering high-quality building, civil construction and project management services across South Australia. The company specialises in managing commercial, government and infrastructure projects from planning through to successful completion and has established a strong reputation for quality, safety and client satisfaction


About the role

As our business continues to expand, we are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead the company's sales, business development and marketing functions. This is a newly established full-time permanent management position reporting directly to senior management and will play a key role in driving business growth, strengthening the company's market presence, and developing long-term relationships with government, commercial and institutional clients


Key responsibilities:

- Develop and implement the company's sales and marketing strategies to achieve sustainable business growth and increase market share.
- Identify new business opportunities, analyse market trends and competitor activities, and develop strategic growth initiatives.
- Lead the company's business development activities by establishing and maintaining relationships with government agencies, developers, consultants, contractors and key industry stakeholders.
- Oversee the preparation of marketing strategies, promotional campaigns and brand positioning to enhance the company's profile within the construction and project management sectors.
- Direct the development and implementation of client relationship management strategies to strengthen customer retention and generate repeat business.
- Work closely with senior management to identify and pursue major project opportunities, including government and private sector procurement and tender opportunities.
- Prepare sales forecasts, marketing budgets, business performance reports and strategic recommendations for senior management.
- Lead, mentor and manage sales and marketing personnel to achieve business objectives and maintain high performance standards.
- Represent the company at industry events, networking functions and stakeholder meetings to promote the company's services and establish strategic partnerships.


Selection criteria:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Management, Commerce or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a senior sales and marketing management role with responsibility for developing and implementing strategic business growth initiatives.
- Proven ability to develop commercial opportunities and build strong relationships with government agencies, commercial clients, developers and key industry stakeholders.
- Strong strategic planning, leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience preparing sales forecasts, marketing plans and business performance reports.
- Previous experience within the building, construction, engineering or project management industry will be highly regarded; applicants with transferable senior sales and marketing management experience from other industries are also encouraged to apply.

Salary: $130,000 per annum (base), plus superannuation
Location: Adelaide, South Australia
How to apply: Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

result.description:
Full-time Broker Group Information Management Coordinator position available in Cranbourne West VIC 3977

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Salary Range: $95,000 $105,000 per annum (exclusive superannuation)
•	Position based in Cranbourne West VIC 3977
•	Opportunity to contribute to the growth, structure and efficiency of a national broker network

Position Overview
finweb operates in the Australian mortgage broking and finance services sector as a broker group supporting mortgage brokers across Australia.

The business provides brokers with access to operational support, onboarding assistance, mentoring, business development resources, compliance coordination, in-house processing support, referral opportunities, CRM systems, workflow tools and practical business resources to help them manage and grow their broker businesses.

finweb is seeking a full-time Broker Group Information Management Coordinator to support the business by managing, analysing and reporting on operational information across broker onboarding, broker/member activity, referral pathways, CRM records, workflow systems, processing support, compliance-related administration and business development initiatives. The successful candidate will assist management by ensuring that operational information is accurately recorded, analysed, reported and used to support business decision-making, workflow efficiency, broker support visibility and organisational growth.

Position Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Analyse broker group operational information, including broker onboarding, CRM activity, referral pathways, workflow progress and processing support activity, to identify trends, delays, risks and improvement opportunities.
•	Maintain accurate business information across CRM systems, MyCRM, Trello, spreadsheets, onboarding trackers, broker registers and internal workflow tools.
•	Prepare operational reports, broker activity summaries, onboarding updates, referral reports, pipeline reports and management insights to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Monitor broker onboarding, accreditation, system access, referral tracking and internal workflow processes to identify stalled matters, missing information, handover issues and operational bottlenecks.
•	Develop and maintain reporting tools, workflow templates, onboarding trackers, broker support registers, checklists, process documents and information management procedures.
•	Review internal systems and workflow records to improve data accuracy, reporting structure, CRM visibility, handover quality and operational efficiency.
•	Support management with business information analysis relating to broker/member operations, referral performance, compliance administration, processing support activity and broker group growth initiatives.
•	Conduct research into mortgage broking market trends, broker group service offerings, aggregator support models, competitor positioning, broker recruitment activity and broker support practices to support business planning and operational development.
•	Maintain structured internal business information resources, including lender information, referral partner information, training materials, compliance resources, processing documentation and onboarding materials, to ensure business information remains accurate, accessible and consistently recorded.
•	Document, track and report broker communications, internal updates and operational information to ensure matters are properly recorded, monitored and escalated where appropriate.
•	Support the implementation of improved reporting, workflow tracking and information management practices across broker onboarding, broker support, processing assistance, referral tracking and member engagement.
•	Ensure all information management, broker communication and operational support activities remain within approved business, licensing and compliance boundaries, with credit advice, legal, licensing, commercial or complex matters escalated to appropriately authorised personnel.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	A bachelor degree or higher qualification in Business, Commerce, Finance, Management, Marketing, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Communications or a related field.
•	At least three years of relevant experience in business information management, operations analysis, CRM administration, pipeline reporting, stakeholder coordination, financial services support, broker support, member support, aggregator support, workflow coordination or operational reporting.
•	Experience using CRM systems, workflow management platforms, reporting tools, spreadsheets, business records, pipeline trackers or other business information systems.
•	Demonstrated ability to interpret operational information and prepare clear management reports, workflow summaries and business insights.
•	Ability to identify process gaps, information inconsistencies and workflow inefficiencies, and recommend practical operational improvements.
•	Knowledge of the Australian mortgage broking, lending, finance, aggregator or professional services sector is highly regarded.

Salary: This is a full-time position with competitive remuneration between $95,000 - $105,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

Retail Buyer

Location: GABBA BROTHERS PTY LTD 
28 PALLADIUM Cct, CLYDE NORTH VIC 3798, AUSTRALIA
 
Salary: AUD $82,000 + 12% Superannuation

Employment Type: Full-time

About Us
Gabba Brothers PTY LTD is a growing Australian scrap metal recycling company specialising in scrap metal recycling, auto and car recycling, and free scrap metal collection services. We purchase, process, and supply a wide range of ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metals, including brass, aluminium, copper, stainless steel, cast iron, and other heavy metals. We are committed to providing outstanding customer service, competitive pricing, and environmentally responsible recycling solutions.

We are looking for a motivated and commercially minded Retail Buyer to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, negotiating purchases, and working in a fast-paced recycling environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in procurement, supplier management, merchandise planning, and inventory control, with the ability to support the company's purchasing and merchandising strategies.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
•	Monitor sales performance, inventory levels, and market trends to support informed purchasing decisions and maintain adequate stock.
•	Research industry developments, supplier information, and market conditions to identify purchasing opportunities and pricing trends.
•	Negotiate purchase prices, supply agreements, and promotional arrangements with suppliers and customers to achieve commercial outcomes.
•	Develop and implement pricing strategies and promotional initiatives to maximise sales and profitability.
•	Collaborate with management to plan purchasing activities, inventory requirements, and long-term business growth strategies.
•	Prepare purchasing plans based on seasonal demand, operational requirements, and budget objectives.
•	Assess the quality, type, and value of ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metals, including copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel, cast iron, and other recyclable materials.
•	Inspect, evaluate, and purchase scrap metal from individuals, businesses, industrial sites, and suppliers, ensuring compliance with company standards.
•	Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, customers, and industry partners to secure a consistent supply of quality recyclable materials.
•	Coordinate with operations staff to ensure efficient collection, delivery, processing, and inventory management of purchased materials.
•	Maintain accurate purchasing records and ensure all transactions comply with company policies and relevant environmental and safety regulations.



About Candidate:
•	Relevant qualification in Business, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Retail Management, or a related field.
•	Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as a Retail Buyer or in a similar procurement or purchasing role.
•	Strong knowledge of purchasing, supplier management, inventory planning, and merchandising.
•	Excellent negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills.
•	Ability to interpret sales data, market trends, and financial reports.
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
•	High level of communication and stakeholder management skills.
•	Proficient in Microsoft Office and inventory or procurement management systems.
•	A proactive and detail-oriented professional committed to continuous improvement and achieving business objectives. 

If you have any doubts or require anything else, please let us know.


How to apply:

Applications open on 2 July 2026 and close on 1 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Target Business Services

Location: 91-109 Main Neerim Road, Neerim South, Victoria 3831
Salary: $80,000 plus 12% superannuation
Position: Full time, Permanent

Our client, AFS Consulting Group Pty. Ltd. trading as Neerim South Hotel, is a well-established hospitality venue located in the heart of Neerim South, Victoria. The hotel offers quality accommodation, a popular bistro, bar facilities, and function spaces, providing a welcoming destination for both local patrons and visitors. The business is committed to delivering high standards of customer service, quality dining, and memorable guest experiences.

The business is seeking to appoint an experienced Hotel Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the hotel, ensuring efficient service delivery across accommodation, food and beverage, and front-of-house operations. The primary purpose of this role is to manage operational performance, lead the hospitality team, maintain compliance with industry regulations, and contribute to the hotel's continued commercial success.

This role is integral to maintaining the hotel's reputation for quality hospitality while driving operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and business growth.

Minimum Requirements:

-	Diploma or equivalent qualification as recognised under the Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF). A qualification in Hospitality Management, Business, or a related discipline is highly desirable.
-	Minimum one year of relevant experience in a similar management role within the hospitality industry.

Key Responsibilities:

-	Oversee the daily operations of the hotel, including accommodation, bar, bistro, functions, and customer service activities.
-	Monitor operational performance to ensure high standards of guest service, cleanliness, and presentation are consistently maintained.
-	Recruit, supervise, train, and evaluate staff while fostering a productive and customer-focused workplace culture.
-	Manage guest enquiries, complaints, and service issues promptly to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
-	Prepare budgets, monitor financial performance, control operating costs, and provide regular reports to the Director.
-	Ensure compliance with liquor licensing, food safety, workplace health and safety, and all relevant regulatory requirements.
-	Coordinate maintenance programs and liaise with contractors to ensure hotel facilities remain safe and well maintained.
-	Manage purchasing, inventory, and supplier relationships to maintain efficient stock control and cost-effective operations.
-	Develop and implement promotional initiatives, functions, and local marketing activities to increase patronage and revenue.
-	Monitor customer feedback and implement continuous improvements to enhance operational performance and guest experience.

Skills and Experience:

-	Demonstrated leadership and team management skills within a hospitality environment.
-	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a strong customer service focus.
-	Sound financial management skills, including budgeting, cost control, and performance reporting.
-	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities in a fast-paced operational environment.
-	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple operational functions.
-	Knowledge of hospitality operations, food and beverage service, accommodation management, and venue promotions.
-	Thorough understanding of relevant hospitality legislation, including liquor licensing, food safety, workplace health and safety, and employment obligations.

To apply, please send your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au
Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.
